# Architecture
> Teaching story. Living project architecture for humans and review grounding. Not Typology seed evidence (see `evidence/typology/architecture_brief.md`).
The `gitboard` architecture organizes the system into functional slices that bridge local Git environments with remote forge data. The system operates through distinct entrypoints and a centralized server interface.
### Entrypoints and Orchestration
The `gitboard` package serves as the primary command-line entrypoint, orchestrating the application lifecycle. Project discovery and view aggregation are handled by `syncproj`, which allows users to select and navigate specific repository contexts.
### Analysis and Jobs
The system processes repository state through specialized logic slices. The `triage` package analyzes project and job data to produce intelligent responses regarding CI status and open work. Complementary to this, `pruneagent` investigates local or removable branches to maintain repository health.
### Connectivity and Intelligence
Integration with external ecosystems is managed via `git-adapters`, which provide standardized clients for GitHub and GitLab APIs. Reasoning capabilities are abstracted through the `llm` package, providing an OpenAI-compatible interface for all intelligence-driven tasks.
### Server and Observability
The application exposes its state and dashboard through the `server` package, which provides HTTP interfaces and mux routing. System reliability and debugging are supported by `observability`, which bootstraps OpenTelemetry (OTEL) and manages error-only inference dumps for analyzing complex LLM interactions.
